title: Stationery suite
slide_intent: Compare everyday communication formats because an identity must remain coherent across different sizes and information loads.
strategic_value: Repeated W marks can connect Whitney’s correspondence, cards, notepad and pens without requiring identical compositions.
demonstration: A gray flat lay groups white letterhead, cards, notepad, envelope and four pens, each using the thin W or Whitney name.
practical_value: Assess how the identity changes proportions between broad stationery and small cards.

content_islands.name: Paper formats
content_islands.spec: Place the letterhead and notepad at left, three cards at upper right and wide envelope below.

content_islands.name: Pens
content_islands.spec: Align the four white pens alongside the cards.

reference_purposes.Application: The official launch caption identifies this photograph as the museum’s stationery suite.
